research_question: Compute the 7-day, 10-year low flow (7Q10) statistic for the Monocacy River at Bridgeport, MD using daily streamflow records from climate years 1943 through 2016.

phase_1.user_prompt: I am conducting a low-flow frequency analysis for the Monocacy River at Bridgeport, Maryland. Can you help me find the exact USGS site number for this location and identify the proper parameter code for daily streamflow (discharge) data?

phase_2.user_prompt: Great. Now I need to retrieve the daily discharge data for this site. Please download the daily data so we can analyze the climate years spanning from 1943 to 2016. In low-flow hydrology, a climate year starts on April 1 of the previous calendar year and ends on March 31 of the named year. Please fetch the exact date range needed to cover this entire period.

phase_3.user_prompt: Now, process the data to find the lowest consecutive 7-day average flow for each climate year (April 1 to March 31). As an intermediate check to ensure our moving averages and year boundaries are correct, what is the annual 7-day minimum flow value for the 1944 climate year?

phase_4.user_prompt: Finally, use the annual 7-day minimum flow series from 1943 to 2016 to estimate the 7Q10 (7-day, 10-year low flow) statistic. Fit a Log-Pearson Type III (LP3) distribution to the base-10 logarithms of the annual 7-day minimum flows. What is the calculated 7Q10 value in cubic feet per second?
